segments.text: Starting my day right fresh orange juice pure health in a glass
Who told you juice is health? Everyone knows that it's fruit. Isn't it from someone who had far too many oranges to sell maybe?
Now that you say it not another word watch this
California the 1920s growers plant orange trees by the million and the harvest outruns what the country can eat
Whole fruit rots in the groves a mountain of oranges. No one will buy
So they hire an advertising man named Albert Laskett to make the surplus disappear
His idea is simple stop eating the fruit drink it one orange in a bite becomes three in a glass
Begin every morning with orange juice for your strength for your children
Then war comes
Scientists freeze the juice into concentrate to ship vitamin C to the troops
The war ends and the factories sit on an ocean of concentrate. They must now sell
So juice is crowned part of a complete balanced breakfast sung by smiling movie stars
They pour it into little boxes hand it to children and stamp it with a cartoon fruit and the word natural
Then the truth strip a fruit of its fiber and you are left with sugar water a glass that hides as much sugar as soda
Sold to you as medicine
Today the healthy shelf is a wall of sugar wearing fruit costumes and we thank them for the favor
Every choice you make
Begins with an idea someone else put in your head
How much have you swallowed only because it was sweet you're free to think what they decide or
Go quiet watch learn like subscribe and evolve quietly until you become the wolf
